summary: The shipped prepared Proposal switch requires the complete original predecessor, physical catalog and assigned source position for either prepared outcome.

substitute-predecessor.defect: A prepared generation can switch after another source transaction advances its predecessor.

substitute-replica-epoch.defect: A prepared generation can cross an unrelated replica epoch with numerically equal coordinates.

substitute-assigned-position.defect: A prepared generation can switch with an assigned source position different from the source position that owns its effects.
